description: Use this when the user asks about one hotel itself: where it is, its check-in and check-out times, its policies, amenities or room types. It returns the hotel's catalogue facts: names, address, coordinates, time zone, check-in and check-out times, the full description, every policy and the amenities, and its room types with include: "roomTypes". "Not listed" is not "no". No prices or availability: get_hotel_offers has those.

locale.description: Language for names and text in the response: en or zh.

name: get_hotel
title: Hotel details
